pages.text: New olive oil filled the jar. Tonight's feast would celebrate its first taste.
Mom baked a big loaf and cut it into pieces. Lulu took the basket. "I will give everyone bread."
Uncle Nino reached for it. "I am quick! Let me serve!"
Uncle Beppo stopped him. "In our day, oldest first." Aunt Rosa grabbed the handle too. "First, prettier plates!"
All three tugged the basket back and forth.
Not one piece had been served. The bread grew cold. The cousins' tummies rumbled.
Lulu picked up a piece of bread in each hand.
Around the table, Lulu put one piece before each person. The three still tugged at the now-empty basket.
Only then did they let go. Everyone dipped bread in the new oil and took a bite. "Mmm!" Their eyes widened.
Lulu held the last piece. Mom dipped it in the oil and popped it into Lulu's mouth.
